overview: AssamRoots is an Assamese-first e-commerce platform connecting the diaspora with authentic Assamese products, with a full vendor marketplace supporting brand and raw material suppliers.
features: Two-type vendor system: Brand Vendors with GSTIN/MRP and Raw Material Vendors with per-kg pricing
Dynamic product submission forms based on vendor type
Admin vendor products panel with type-specific pricing review
Email notifications for vendor approvals and product status
